findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.

EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
findings.explanation: Your liability is capped at the fees paid, but your obligations under Paragraph 9 (which covers independent contractor status and related tax responsibilities) are excluded from this cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited liability for those matters.
findings.suggested_change: Except with respect to Contractor's indemnification obligations, Contractor's maximum liability to Company arising for any reason relating to Contractor's performance of Services under a Statement of Work shall be limited to the amount of fees paid to Contractor for the performance of such services.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a good week. I am looking forward to getting started, but I would like to request a few adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause where my liability is capped at the fees paid, the exception for obligations under Paragraph 9 exposes me to potentially unlimited liability; I propose changing this so that liability is capped except for standard indemnification obligations.
